track_1.mp3.prompt: Upbeat modern electronic pop instrumental at exactly 128 BPM, 4/4, for a fast, playful product sizzle reel: punchy four-on-the-floor kick from the first beat, crisp claps on 2 and 4, bright plucky synth hook, driving sidechained bass, shiny percussion and fills every 4 bars, a quick riser into a bigger chorus after 8 bars, confident and fun, ending with a clean final hit on the downbeat. Steady tempo throughout, no tempo changes, no vocals.
